title: Beyond Bot Labels: Retrospective Consequence-Grounded Ranking of Attributed Cache Harm in E-Commerce Logs
abstract: arXiv:2611.18027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web caches reduce origin load and latency, but automated traffic can either warm them or evict objects shoppers reuse, lowering the cache hit ratio (CHR). Existing bot defenses generally infer automation from User-Agent (UA) strings or behavior rather than identify sessions that impose cross-session cache harm. We instead formulate the task as ranking sessions by eviction damage and propose consequence-grounded session ranking. A single chronological replay attributes each eviction-induced miss by a protected shopping session (a victim) to the session whose insertion last evicted the object. A behavioral model predicts the target from session behavior alone. Selected sessions bypass the cache but remain origin-served. In a controlled check of 539 non-victim sessions selected across harm levels, attribution order tracks victim-hit changes after removal (Spearman correlation 0.80). translated_title: 超越机器人标签：电商日志中基于后果的缓存危害归因回溯排序
translated_abstract: 网络缓存能够降低源站负载与延迟，但自动化流量既可能为缓存预热，也可能驱逐购物者重复使用的对象，从而降低缓存命中率（CHR）。现有的机器人防御方法通常通过User-Agent（UA）字符串或行为来推断自动化特征，而非识别那些造成跨会话缓存危害的会话。我们转而将该任务表述为按驱逐损害对会话进行排序，并提出基于后果的会话排序方法。通过一次按时间顺序的重放，将受保护购物会话（受害者）因驱逐而产生的每次未命中归因于最后插入并驱逐该对象的会话；行为模型仅凭会话行为即可预测该目标。被选中的会话绕过缓存，但仍由源站提供服务。在跨危害程度选取的539个非受害者会话的受控检验中，归因排序能够追踪移除后受害者命中情况的变化（Spearman相关系数为0.80）。在一个包含1270万条请求的真实追踪数据上，排名前1%的会话……
tldr: 该论文提出基于后果的会话排序方法，通过按时间顺序回溯重放将缓存驱逐造成的未命中归因到具体会话，从而识别并绕过对电商缓存命中率造成跨会话危害的自动化流量。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes consequence-grounded session ranking, which retrospectively attributes eviction-induced cache misses to responsible sessions via a single chronological replay, enabling identification and bypassing of automated traffic that causes cross-session cache harm in e-commerce.
